changes.result: On macOS, capture now requires LiveContext capabilities that identify executable /usr/bin/sandbox-exec and /bin/sh with nonempty digests, lengths, and executable modes. A bounded no-target preflight must succeed before launch. Unsupported hosts reject before spawn.

The deny-default profile explicitly denies network, process-fork, signal, file-clone, and file-link operations. It contains no file-write allowance. The serialized observation records the sandbox executable digest, profile digest, denied effect categories, empty write scopes, and preflight result.

Read and PlannedWrite use the same zero-write profile. WorkspaceWrite, ExternalWrite, and Destructive reject before spawn. Workspace-scoped writes were not represented as supported because a path-subtree profile cannot truthfully exclude hard-link alias writes without a descriptor-brokered write substrate.

macOS launches only a descriptor-pinned shebang script whose interpreter is fixed /bin/sh. Non-shebang executables and other interpreters reject before target launch. A persistent path replacement rejects; a swap-and-restore can execute only the already pinned original descriptor.

Timeout and interruption terminate the bound process group before reaping, poll for exit before escalation, and preserve cleanup errors causally. The prior post-reap process-group signal was removed to eliminate PID-reuse signaling risk. Fork denial prevents descendant or detached-session escape.
Read and PlannedWrite captures retain the stable tree witness and final LiveContext revalidation. Sandbox-denied writes return an observed nonzero CapturedRun without mutating the candidate.

findings.finding: No truthful descriptor-brokered write substrate exists. All write-capable effect classes therefore reject before spawn; HCT-CAPTURE cannot support setup, retrofit, repair, migration, or other workspace-mutating product commands.

Descriptor-safe launch currently supports only fixed-/bin/sh shebang scripts. Native executables are rejected to avoid the macOS non-shebang path-swap race, so the typed Rust CLI cannot yet be captured through this implementation.
Non-macOS hosts reject before spawn because no proven equivalent sandbox is implemented.

The sandbox still grants broad file-read and process-exec operations so /bin/sh and system runtime dependencies function. Network, writes, fork, cross-process signals, file links, and clones are denied, but least-privilege read and executable allowlists remain unproved.

A chained shell verification surface denied nested sandbox-exec with exit 71 while a pure Cargo invocation passed. Runtime preflight correctly rejects before target launch, but supported operator invocation surfaces require root reconciliation.
